Package game.wanderer

package game.wanderer
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    game
     
  • Class
    Description
    AskForecastAction
    The Action an actor performs when it asks a Wanderer for tomorrow's forecast.
    CampfireReaction
    The reaction to cold weather: lights a Fire on tiles adjacent to the given Location, with more tiles catching alight the colder the temperature in the reading that triggered it.
    DroughtOmen
    The omen of a hot, dry forecast: drains the asking actor's stamina over the following turns, via DroughtWearinessStatus.
    DroughtWearinessStatus
    The weariness brought on by a drought forecast: drains an actor's stamina for a fixed number of turns.
    ForecastOmen
    What tomorrow's weather brings when the Farmer asks the Wanderer for the forecast, such as frost that stops nearby plants from growing.
    FrostOmen
    The omen of a cold forecast: pauses the growth of every Plant around the Wanderer for a duration that grows with how far below freezing tomorrow's temperature is.
    RainDanceReaction
    The reaction to rain: over an area around the given Location that grows with the rainfall in the reading that triggered it, turns bare, tillable ground to Soil and gives every freely-waterable crop a free watering.
    ReactToWeatherAction
    The Action an actor performs when it reacts to the weather around it.
    SowingOmen
    The omen of a rainy forecast: a new StrawberrySeedling takes root on every bare Soil tile around the Wanderer.
    StormShelterGround
    Ground sheltered against a storm.
    StormShelterReaction
    The reaction to a strong wind: builds a StormShelterGround on every tile adjacent to the given Location, blocking them for a duration that grows with the wind speed in the reading that triggered it.
    UnreadableSkyAction
    Wraps the Wanderer's ordinary wandering Action for a turn when the current weather could not be read (no API key, no network, or the request failed), so the Farmer is told why no weather effect happened, as well as seeing the Wanderer move as usual.
    Wanderer
    An actor whose behaviour depends on the real weather at the place the map represents.
    WeatherInterpreter
    Decides which WeatherReaction a current weather reading triggers, and which ForecastOmen a forecast reading triggers, so that no other class needs to name a concrete reaction or omen.
    WeatherReaction
    What the Wanderer does to the farm because of the weather where it stands right now, such as lighting a campfire in the cold.
